entries.anchor: Step 2b: Record evidence for every rule you changed
entries.rationale: Issue #736: the authoring flow had no step producing evidence, so per-rule rationale + session pointers were never attached to a published dossier. Inserted between Edit and Sign so evidence is recorded before the checksum it must match is finalized.

entries.anchor: Step 3: Sign, lint, verify — in this order, signing last
entries.rationale: sign regenerates the dossier checksum; evidence sync must run after sign so the sidecar's recorded checksum matches the just-signed dossier, otherwise publish rejects it with EVIDENCE_MISMATCH.

entries.anchor: Step 2b: Record evidence for every rule you changed
entries.rationale: ai-dossier evidence add/init (cli 0.48.0, ai-dossier#743) now compute a missing checksum from the body themselves, so the checksum --update workaround between publish-dossier's Step 2 (deletes checksum) and Step 3 (sign restores it) is no longer needed.
A retired machine was dropped from the fleet on 2026-09-09; refresh-fleet.sh is the canonical refresh; cite ai-dossier#749

entries.anchor: Step 2b: Record evidence for every rule you changed
entries.rationale: Dropped the manual --session incantation since ai-dossier#750 made evidence add default and validate the session id on its own, and a copied incantation was exactly how a placeholder session (claude-session-fc749) got recorded in the publish-dossier@1.1.2 sidecar in the first place (ai-dossier#749).

scripts/refresh-fleet.sh no longer hard-codes the operator's host list (ai-dossier#1049/#1051): the hosts come from REFRESH_FLEET_HOSTS / REFRESH_FLEET_LOCAL_HOST, and a bare run without them now exits non-zero instead of silently refreshing only the local machine. The step documents the env setup and the --local-only path so a refresh never quietly skips hosts.
